AI Overview
You can play the online puzzle at Duotrigordle, where you must solve 32 Wordle boards simultaneously using 37 shared guesses. 
Duotrigordle
 +1
How It Works
Shared Input: Every 5-letter word you type applies to all 32 boards at the same time. 
Color Hints: Green means the letter is right and in the correct spot; yellow means the letter is in the word but the wrong spot; gray means the letter is not in the word. 
duotrigordle.org
 +1
Board Freezing: Once you solve a board, it locks so you can focus on the remaining active grids. 
Game Modes: Features Daily Duotrigordle, Daily Sequence (boards appear one after another), Daily Jumble, and an Unlimited Practice Mode. 
Duotrigordle
 +2
Popular Strategies
Broad Openers: Start with high-coverage words containing common vowels and consonants (such as CRANE, SLATE, or a 3-word combo like TEARS, POUND, CLIMB) to gather early clues.
